item.title: Anti-ICE protestors block vehicles, hurl objects and trash at NYPD officers
item.description: Police charged several protestors who attempted to interfere with an Immigration and Customs Enforcement operation in New York City by hurling objects at vehicles and screaming obscenities at authorities. #immigration #ICE #NYPD #deportation #illegalimmigration #NewYork #Trump

item.title: Scholar wins Grawemeyer Award for book on enslaved ghostwriters of the Bible
item.description: In her 2024 book, "God's Ghostwriters: Enslaved Christians and the Making of the Bible," biblical scholar Candida Moss recognizes the contributions of many enslaved Christians and ghostwriters, like Tertius, who wrote down Paul’s letters to the Romans. #CandidaMoss #GrawemeyerAward #Religion

item.title: Matt Van Epps defeats Aftyn Behn in heavily watched Tennessee special election
item.description: Matt Van Epps has defeated Democrat Aftyn Behn in a nationally watched Tennessee election that helped Republicans keep their majority in the United States House of Representatives. #AftynBehn #Behn #Tennessee #VanEpps #Republican #specialelection #Trump

item.title: Seahawks player rejoices that he got his 'Lord and Savior Jesus Christ back'
item.description: Seattle Seahawks linebacker Ernest Jones is rejoicing now that he's gotten his “Lord and Savior Jesus Christ back.” #NationalFootballLeague #X #SeattleSeahawks #ErnestJones

item.title: Lilly Endowment gives $649M in grants to prepare pastors for future, tell Christian stories
item.description: The Lilly Endowment, America’s largest private foundation, announced it has awarded $649 million in grants to 93 religious organizations to help prepare pastors for the future and tell stories about Christian life. #LillyEndowment #Pastors #Future #Stories

item.title: Kirk Cameron returns with season 2 of ‘Iggy and Mr. Kirk,' talks identity, AI and raising kids in a digital age
item.description: Kirk Cameron is back this Christmas with season two of “Iggy and Mr. Kirk,” his live-action children’s series featuring puppetry, music and Bible-based lessons aimed at ages 4 to 8. #IggyandMrKirk #KirkCameron #faith #kidsshow

item.title: Episcopal seminary appoints interim president after firing leader for 'inappropriate relationship'
item.description: A Texas seminary affiliated with The Episcopal Church has appointed an interim president and dean after firing its previous president over an “inappropriate relationship” with an employee. #SeminaryoftheSouthwest #EpiscopalChurch #Texas #inappropriaterelationship

item.title: Christian OU student flunked after calling gender ideology 'demonic'
item.description: A Christian pre-med student has gone viral in recent days after filing a religious discrimination complaint that claims a trans-identified teaching assistant flunked her for an essay stating that gender ideology is "demonic." #SamanthaFulnecky #UniversityofOklahoma #education #Oklahoma

item.title: Apologist Frank Turek rejects claim dispensationalism is 'heresy,' says End Times remain 'veiled'
item.description: Christian apologist Frank Turek recently pushed back against claims that dispensationalism and Christian Zionism are heresies, but acknowledged the details of the End Times remain "veiled" and are subject to disagreement among Christians. #FrankTurek #dispensationalism #EndTimes #premillennialism #ChristianZionism #Israel

item.title: Court rules NY's efforts to censor pro-life pregnancy centers unconstitutional
item.description: An appeals court panel has ruled that efforts to stop pro-life pregnancy centers in New York from informing patients about abortion pill reversal are unconstitutional, as such organizations find themselves increasingly subject to investigations from Democratic politicians. #FirstAmendment #Abortion #NewYork #LetitiaJames #AllianceDefendingFreedom
